review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion compatibility and query reliability
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 adds a defensive type check before converting Clerk timestamp fields, retaining ISO strings and numeric strings unchanged instead of raising TypeError. This prevents import failures and downstream query errors when the Clerk API returns timestamps in formats other than epoch milliseconds, preserving the warehouse ingestion pipeline and compatibility.
